about: A data principal's own words and the kind of request they are (app/routers/rights_requests.py KIND_OPTIONS). Includes messages that are not requests at all. Ground truth; never edited to make a model pass.

cases.details: Please send me a copy of all the personal data you hold about me and tell me who you have shared it with.
What information do you have on me? I would like to know how it is being used.
My address on file is wrong. I moved to 14 Park Street last year, please update it.
The date of birth in my account is incorrect; it should be 3 May 1990.
I withdraw my consent. Delete my account and everything you have about me.
Please erase my phone number and email address from your records permanently.
If anything happens to me, I want my daughter Priya Sharma to be able to manage my data with you.
I asked for my data 45 days ago and nobody has replied. This is unacceptable and I want to complain.
Your staff shared my medical details with my employer without asking me. I am filing a complaint.
Hello, is this the right email address for customer support?
Thanks for the quick delivery, great service!
